  444: - Exact quasiparticle: Gamma/omega = 0 for all 6 branches at N_pair = 1 (Session 53)
  445: - Double triviality: all GL Berry phases = 0, all Zak phases = 0, GL block-diagonal (Session 53)
  446: - BCS gradient exceeds geometric gradient at fold: |dE_cond/dV_KK| = 1.30 (Session 53)
  447: - Van Hove amplification: 400x derivative-to-value ratio (Session 53)
  448: - Speed bump at tau = 0.2015 (local maximum, not minimum) (Session 53)

  451: - BLV acoustic metric formula: a_acoustic = a_geom * sqrt(rho/c_s) (exact, 4 numerical tests)
  452: - 229x sound speed hierarchy: c_fabric/c_Gold = 229.5, giving 2.72 acoustic e-folds
  453: - Jensen volume preservation: expansion is 100% acoustic, 0% KK volume transfer
  454: - T_init = 0.112 * M_KK = 8.32e15 GeV (GUT scale, zero free parameters)
  455: - Phonon EOS: w = 0.202 (decelerating, NOT inflationary)
